sentiment.rationale: Forward guidance was reduced: Q4 revenues expected down mid-teens, gross margins down 400-500 bps, and management explicitly stated headwinds will continue into fiscal 2026. The CEO acknowledged 'we are not satisfied with our overall results' and the CFO described the operating environment as 'dynamic' with multiple external uncertainties including tariffs and geopolitical risks. The guidance reduction and cautious forward language drive a clearly negative sentiment score.

summary.revenue: $11.3 billion, down 9% reported and down 7% currency-neutral versus prior year.
summary.eps: Diluted EPS $0.54, down 30% versus prior year.
summary.guidance: Q4 revenues expected down mid-teens (low end), gross margins down 400-500 bps including tariff impacts, SG&A up low to mid-single digits. Headwinds expected to continue into fiscal 2026.
summary.margin: Gross margin decreased 330 bps to 41.5% due to higher discounts, inventory obsolescence, product costs, and channel mix.
key_risks: Classic footwear franchises (Air Force 1, Dunk, Air Jordan 1) declining faster than overall business, requiring rightsizing through fiscal 2026.
Inventory remains elevated across all geographies, requiring continued liquidation actions.
Greater China traffic declined double digits and retail sales underperformed plan; competition more aggressive than remembered.
External uncertainties: geopolitical dynamics, new tariffs, volatile FX, and impact on consumer confidence.
Q4 guidance includes negative impact from newly implemented tariffs on imports from China and Mexico.
key_opportunities: Performance business (running, training) growing, led by new product launches like Pegasus Premium and Vomero 18.
Running grew mid-single digits; Vomero 5 doubled revenue; Shox grew over 10x in last three quarters.
New innovation pipeline for Spring '26 reviewed positively; management expressed confidence in product portfolio transition.
Wholesale order book in North America, EMEA, APLA shows growth in performance dimensions nearly offsetting classic franchise declines.
NIKE Digital repositioning to full-price model: promotional days reduced from over 30 to zero in Jan/Feb North America.

management_tone.label: mixed
management_tone.justification: CEO expresses confidence in strategic direction ('I'm even more convinced that these are the right actions') while simultaneously acknowledging unsatisfactory results and significant headwinds ahead ('we are not satisfied with our overall results', 'the operating environment is dynamic').
